apps.name: Catalyst
apps.subtitle: An on-device app store with Enterprise signing.
apps.localizedDescription:
Catalyst installs and refreshes apps right on your iPhone, no computer needed.

• Apple ID signing, like SideStore
• Enterprise signing with your own .p12 and .mobileprovision: no Apple ID, no 3-app limit, no 7-day refresh
• Enterprise-signed apps don't show the 7-day timer
• Black theme with a touch of purple

Based on SideStore and AltStore. Licensed under AGPLv3.

news.title: Welcome to Catalyst
news.caption: Thanks for trying Catalyst! Install apps with your Apple ID, or switch to Enterprise signing in Settings › Advanced › Enterprise Signing.

news.title: Enterprise Signing
news.caption: Import your own .p12 and .mobileprovision to sign apps without an Apple ID. Enterprise-signed apps skip the 7-day timer.

news.title: Nightly Builds
news.caption: Every push to main publishes a fresh nightly build. Expect rough edges.
